name: TANCO
recent: Tanco 与 CNECC Engineering (Malaysia) 的联营公司获得价值 RM700 million 的 Pulau Indah 物流仓库建筑合约。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 9 日召开第 67 届常年股东大会，议程包括重选董事、批准董事费及更新股份回购授权与关联交易授权。最新财报显示 2026 财年末季营收按年增长 19.5%，但净利由盈转亏。
notable: Tanco 与 CNECC Engineering (Malaysia) 的联营公司获得价值 RM700 million 的 Pulau Indah 物流仓库建筑合约。
公司将于 2026 年 12 月 9 日召开第 67 届常年股东大会。
risks: 集团董事经理 Dato' Sri Andrew Tan Jun Suan 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
集团董事经理及一名子公司董事通知公司，有意在季度业绩公布前的闭窗期交易公司证券。
最新财报显示 2026 财年末季净利由上年同期盈利转为亏损 RM3.351 million。
earnings: 2026 财年末季（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM38.762 million，按年增长 19.5%，按季增长 9.7%；净亏损为 RM3.351 million，净利率 -8.6%，上年同期净利率为 0.3%。

recent_en: Tanco's joint venture with CNECC Engineering (Malaysia) has secured a RM700 million logistics warehouse construction contract in Pulau Indah. The latest financial results show 4Q FY2026 revenue up 19.5% year-on-year, but the group swung to a net loss.
notable_en: Tanco's joint venture with CNECC Engineering (Malaysia) secured a RM700 million logistics warehouse construction contract in Pulau Indah.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Andrew Tan Jun Suan acquired shares in the open market multiple times between September and October 2026.
The Group Managing Director and a subsidiary director notified the company of their intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period pending the quarterly results announcement.
The latest financial results show a net loss of RM3.351 million for 4Q FY2026, compared with a profit in the prior year corresponding period.
earnings_en: For 4Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM38.762 million, up 19.5% year-on-year and 9.7% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM3.351 million with a net margin of -8.6%, compared with a net margin of 0.3% in the prior year corresponding period.
